name: crudui
description: YAML-based form generation and validation system (Multi-language, Multi-framework)

scripts.build: npm run build:validator && npm run build:generators
scripts.build:generators: npm run build -w @crudui/generator-core && npm run build -w @crudui/generator-html && npm run build -w @crudui/generator-react && npm run build -w @crudui/generator-vue && npm run build -w @crudui/generator-svelte
scripts.docs:prepare: npm run manifest:docs && npm run docs:api && npm run spec:schema
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:prepare && node scripts/docs-site/cli.mjs build
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:prepare && node scripts/docs-site/cli.mjs dev
scripts.docs:preview: npm run docs:prepare && node scripts/docs-site/cli.mjs preview
scripts.docs:check:all: npm run manifest:check && npm run manifest:docs:check && npm run docs:check:documents && npm run docs:check
scripts.test:forms: node scripts/require-current-build.mjs && npm test -w @crudui/generator-core && npm test -w @crudui/generator-html && npm test -w @crudui/generator-react && npm test -w @crudui/generator-vue && npm test -w @crudui/generator-svelte && node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- tests/fixtures/form-render/normalize.test.mjs tests/form-styles.test.mjs tests/form-markup/naming.test.mjs examples/product-forms/examples.test.mjs && node scripts/run-tests.mjs node --timeout 120 -- tests/widget-script-runs.test.mjs
scripts.test:form-comparison: npm run test:form-comparison:build && npm run test:form-comparison:browser
scripts.test:form-comparison:build: npm run test:form-comparison:source && npm run test:form-comparison:library
scripts.test:form-comparison:source: npm run build:validator && npm run build -w @crudui/generator-core && npm run build -w @crudui/generator-html && node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- examples/form-comparison/browser-report.test.mjs examples/form-comparison/check-*.test.mjs examples/form-comparison/container-runtime.test.mjs examples/form-comparison/public/*.test.mjs examples/form-comparison/src/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:form-comparison:pipeline: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- examples/form-comparison/record-stores.test.mjs && node scripts/run-tests.mjs go --cwd examples/form-comparison/servers/go -- ./... && node scripts/run-tests.mjs cargo -- --locked --manifest-path examples/form-comparison/servers/rust/Cargo.toml && node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- examples/form-comparison/pipeline.browser.mjs
scripts.test:runtimes: node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- tests/build/runtime-version-policy.test.mjs tests/build/form-comparison-ci.test.mjs tests/build/make-tool-path.test.mjs tests/build/rust-node-entry-points.test.mjs tests/build/conformance-evidence.test.mjs tests/build/unicode-properties.test.mjs tests/build/github-repository.test.mjs tests/build/php-extensions.test.mjs tests/build/ci-local.test.mjs tests/build/run-tests.test.mjs tests/build/test-commands.test.mjs tests/build/contract-manifest.test.mjs
scripts.test:build: node scripts/run-tests.mjs node -- tests/build/public-packages.test.mjs tests/build/vite-config.test.mjs tests/build/ci-browser.test.mjs tests/build/package-consumer-pack.test.mjs tests/build/lint-coverage.test.mjs tests/build/bounded-commands.test.mjs
